criterion_descriptions: Navigate to Magnus Carlsen’s profile on Chess.com (e.g., https://www.chess.com/players/magnus-carlsen) and view the page while not signed in. Full credit if the correct profile page is opened and accessible without login. Full credit also if access is blocked by an uncontrollable factor (login wall, CAPTCHA, geo/age gate, consent wall that cannot be dismissed, site error/outage) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and that it prevented viewing the ratings. Partial credit if the agent initially lands on an incorrect/other player page but then corrects to the correct profile (or clearly attempts to). No credit if the agent does not attempt Chess.com first when it is accessible or fabricates having accessed the page.

Identify and report Magnus Carlsen’s current Blitz rating from the profile exactly as displayed (including any symbols/formatting shown next to the rating, such as provisional markers or separators, if present). Full credit if the Blitz rating is captured verbatim from the visible profile page. Partial credit if a Blitz rating is reported but formatting/characters are missing or the source is ambiguous. Full credit if the profile is accessible but the Blitz rating is not visible due to an uncontrollable UI/privacy/region/consent limitation without signing in, and the agent clearly states it cannot be seen and does not guess. No credit if the agent fabricates a rating or reports the wrong time control/player.

Identify and report Magnus Carlsen’s current Bullet rating from the profile exactly as displayed (including any symbols/formatting shown next to the rating, such as provisional markers or separators, if present). Full credit if the Bullet rating is captured verbatim from the visible profile page. Partial credit if a Bullet rating is reported but formatting/characters are missing or the source is ambiguous. Full credit if the profile is accessible but the Bullet rating is not visible due to an uncontrollable UI/privacy/region/consent limitation without signing in, and the agent clearly states it cannot be seen and does not guess. No credit if the agent fabricates a rating or reports the wrong time control/player.

Comply with constraints by not signing in and not challenging/messaging/otherwise interacting with any player. Stop once Blitz and Bullet ratings are recorded, or once it is clearly impossible to view them due to an uncontrollable access/visibility blocker (and the agent reports that). Full credit if the agent performs only passive viewing/navigation (scrolling is fine) and stops at the appropriate point. Partial credit if the agent takes minor extra non-interactive steps but still remains within constraints. No credit if the agent signs in or initiates any interaction (challenge/message).
